title: GeoFlowVLM: Geometry-Aware Joint Uncertainty for Frozen Vision-Language Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2605.13352v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Frozen vision-language models (VLMs) typically represent images and text as deterministic embeddings, which do not directly provide estimates of aleatoric uncertainty arising from ambiguous image--text correspondences or epistemic uncertainty reflecting limited data support. We consider the post-hoc uncertainty quantification setting in which probabilistic adapters are trained on frozen VLM embeddings. Existing methods either fit unimodal distributions around individual embeddings, often in Euclidean space, or learn densities for each modality separately. Most address only one type of uncertainty, and to our knowledge, none learns a joint density of image and text embeddings. We propose \textit{GeoFlowVLM}, which learns a flexible joint density of image and text embeddings on the product of two hyperspheres using a single masked Riemannian flow matching model. translated_title: GeoFlowVLM：面向冻结视觉-语言嵌入的几何感知联合不确定性
translated_abstract: 冻结的视觉-语言模型通常将图像和文本表示为确定性的嵌入向量，无法直接估计由模糊的图像-文本对应关系引起的偶然不确定性，也无法估计反映数据支持有限的认知不确定性。我们考虑事后不确定性量化场景，即在冻结的VLM嵌入之上训练概率适配器。现有方法要么在单个嵌入周围拟合单峰分布（通常在欧几里得空间中），要么分别学习每个模态的密度。大多数方法仅处理一种类型的不确定性，且据我们所知，尚无方法学习图像与文本嵌入的联合密度。我们提出GeoFlowVLM，它利用单个掩码黎曼流匹配模型，在两个超球面的乘积空间上学习图像和文本嵌入的灵活联合密度。该模型同时提供边际密度和条件密度，由此我们可以（估计两种不确定性）。
tldr: GeoFlowVLM通过单个掩码黎曼流匹配模型在双超球面乘积空间上学习图像与文本嵌入的联合密度，首次实现了对冻结VLM嵌入的偶然与认知不确定性的几何感知联合量化。
en_tdlr: GeoFlowVLM learns a flexible joint density of image and text embeddings on the product of two hyperspheres via a single masked Riemannian flow matching model, enabling geometry-aware joint quantification of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty for frozen VLM embeddings.
